founder.name: Vikas Gothi
founder.title: Founder & Principal Artist
founder.quote: "Art is the quiet bridge between an observant eye, a steady hand, and a sensitive human heart."
founder.bioParagraph1: Based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, Vikas Gothi has earned deep respect as a portraitist, large-scale rangoli maestro, and passionate educator. Driven by an unrelenting commitment to classical discipline, Vikas has spent over a decade honing the delicate chemistry of dry mediums—charcoal, graphite, soft pastel—and the fluid lyricism of oil and acrylic painting on canvas.
founder.bioParagraph2: Disillusioned with how modern art coaching was turning into commercial shortcuts, Vikas established The Art Horizon as an authentic atelier where young children, serious teenagers, and adult professionals could receive genuine, personalized mentorship at their own pace.

announcements.title: International Online Art Admissions Open — Junior, Young & Senior Batches
announcements.shortDescription: Live interactive Zoom art classes for kids aged 6 to 15 now open for international students across the USA, UK, UAE, Oman, Kuwait, and worldwide.
announcements.fullDescription: Admissions are officially open for our 3-month structured International Online Art Classes led by The Art Horizon. Classes run live on Zoom with small batches of 4 to 6 students, 8 live classes per month, English-language instruction, and age-appropriate batches for Junior Artist (6–8 Years), Young Artist (9–11 Years), and Senior Artist (12–15 Years). Book a free demo session today to experience our teaching approach.

announcements.title: Weekend Studio Workshops: Resin Art, Kutch Lippan & Clay Creations
announcements.shortDescription: Join hands-on creative weekend workshops at our Indore studio. All materials provided and every participant takes home a finished artwork.
announcements.fullDescription: Experience mindful hands-on making at The Art Horizon studio in Usha Nagar, Indore. Our weekend workshops cover Ocean Epoxy Resin Art, Traditional Kutch Lippan Mud & Mirror Art, and Terracotta Clay Pottery. Prior registration is required due to limited studio seating.

announcements.title: Student Achievement Spotlight: Bal Krishna Charcoal & Wildlife Studies
announcements.shortDescription: Celebrating our academy students whose original charcoal portraits and canvas wildlife paintings were featured in this season’s studio showcase.
announcements.fullDescription: We take immense pride in showcasing authentic drawings and canvas paintings completed by students under the direct mentorship of Vikas Gothi. Explore full-resolution student works inside the Artwork Gallery.

galleryPhotos.title: Wisdom of Generations – Elder in Turban in Charcoal Realism
galleryPhotos.medium: Nitram Charcoal & Graphite on Archival Fabriano Cotton Paper
galleryPhotos.description: Soul-stirring high-contrast classical portrait depicting an Indian village elder with weathered facial character, flowing mustache, and intricately layered turban. Masterful tonal chiaroscuro capturing dignity and lifelike gaze.

galleryPhotos.title: Galloping Wild Steeds – Dynamic Motion & Mane Study
galleryPhotos.medium: Pencil & Graphite Powder on Textured Cartridge Sheet
galleryPhotos.description: Breathtaking kinetic sketch of running wild horses with windblown flowing manes and anatomical muscle rendering. Created during advanced teen sketching classes under Vikas Gothi.

galleryPhotos.title: Serenity in Bodhi Leaves – Contemporary Spiritual Buddha
galleryPhotos.artist: Vikas Gothi / The Art Horizon Studio
galleryPhotos.description: Contemplative spiritual painting blending dual-tone indigo and golden ochre lighting on the peaceful visage of Lord Buddha, framed by lush translucent Bodhi leaves.

galleryPhotos.title: Bal Krishna Divine Charcoal Study
galleryPhotos.medium: Nitram Charcoal & Graphite on Archival Cartridge Paper
galleryPhotos.artist: Student of The Art Horizon (Mentored by Vikas Gothi)
galleryPhotos.description: Original student artwork created at The Art Horizon. Young student proudly displays her completed Bal Krishna tonal portraits featuring expressive eyes, peacock feather detailing, and refined charcoal blending.

galleryPhotos.title: Vibrant Wildlife Elephant with Luminous Blue Eye
galleryPhotos.medium: Acrylics & Textured Brushwork on Canvas Board
galleryPhotos.description: Striking wildlife study painted by student Akku, displaying radiant warm-to-cool transitions along the elephant trunk, detailed skin wrinkle texturing, and a captivating glowing blue eye.

galleryPhotos.title: Serene Sunset Lake & Wooden Pier
galleryPhotos.description: Atmospheric landscape painting featuring calm waters reflecting the golden sunset, misty mountain ridges, and a one-point perspective wooden boardwalk.

galleryPhotos.title: Hummingbird & Dewdrop Magnolia Blossoms
galleryPhotos.medium: Fine Acrylic & Soft Glazes on Linen Canvas
galleryPhotos.description: Luminous botanical painting by student Kuku capturing a ruby-throated hummingbird hovering over dewy pink and golden magnolia blossoms on deep teal gradient background.

galleryPhotos.title: Forest Deer & Monarch Butterflies
galleryPhotos.medium: Acrylic & Oil Blends on Textured Canvas
galleryPhotos.description: Gentle forest creature study depicting a spotted deer with branching antlers surrounded by fluttering yellow and electric blue butterflies in dappled woodland light.

galleryPhotos.title: Contemporary Couple Mini Canvas Illustration
galleryPhotos.medium: Acrylic & Fine Line Work on Miniature Canvas
galleryPhotos.description: Modern, heartwarming pop-art style portrait painted on mini canvas during a studio workshop, held in front of The Art Horizon creative workstation.

galleryPhotos.title: Radha Krishna – Modern Devotion on Easel (2025)
galleryPhotos.description: Masterpiece on wooden studio easel handcrafted in 2025 by Vikas Gothi. Combines bold cubist-inspired facial facets, Krishna playing the golden flute, vibrant saffron background, and exquisite emotional intimacy.

galleryPhotos.title: Symphony in Color – Musical Violin Wall Mural
galleryPhotos.medium: Vibrant Acrylics, Weatherproof Silk Sealer & Mixed Pigments
galleryPhotos.description: Hand-painted live wall mural executed by Vikas Gothi, featuring a classical cello/violin surrounded by swirling musical staves and an impressionistic burst of yellow, emerald green, and cobalt blue.

galleryPhotos.title: Sacred Mandala & Heritage Floral Wall Art
galleryPhotos.medium: Natural Terracotta Pigments & Fine Detail Acrylics
galleryPhotos.description: Intricate hand-painted circular mandala mural executed with immaculate rotational symmetry, textured petals, and earthen terracotta tones by Vikas Gothi.

galleryPhotos.title: Academic Cranial & Facial Anatomy Study
galleryPhotos.medium: Sanguine & Charcoal on Toned Archival Paper
galleryPhotos.description: Rigorous anatomical study analyzing human skull proportions, facial muscle groups (zygomaticus, masseter), planar head construction, and bone articulation for realistic portraiture.

galleryPhotos.title: Heritage Portrait in Oil on Linen
galleryPhotos.medium: Fine Oil on Stretched Belgian Linen Canvas
galleryPhotos.description: Commissioned classical oil portrait with multi-layered glazes, rich warm skin tones, chiaroscuro lighting, and archival protective varnishing.

galleryPhotos.title: The Patriarch in Contemplation
galleryPhotos.medium: Nitram Charcoal & White Chalk on Fabriano Cotton Paper
galleryPhotos.description: Hyperrealistic charcoal study capturing deep textural wisdom, subtle skin folds, and nuanced lighting from a soft directional window source.

galleryPhotos.title: Luminous Child Portrait in Colour Pencil
galleryPhotos.medium: Faber-Castell Polychromos & Caran d’Ache on Archival Paper
galleryPhotos.description: Vivid, velvety portrait drawing created with multi-layered colored pencil pigments, capturing joyful childish laughter, glowing skin tones, and delicate hair highlights.

galleryPhotos.title: Sahasradala Lotus Rangoli
galleryPhotos.medium: Natural Lake Pigments, Ground Marble Powder & Flower Petals
galleryPhotos.description: Record-scale festival floor installation executed for a landmark celebration in Indore, with mathematical symmetry and 12-layer color gradation.

galleryPhotos.title: Traditional Kutch Lippan Mud & Mirror Art
galleryPhotos.medium: Hand-Rolled Ceramic Clay, Convex Mirrors & Distemper Wash
galleryPhotos.description: Authentic mud-and-mirror wall centerpiece made with traditional geometric coil borders and concentric mirrors that sparkle with changing room ambient light.

galleryPhotos.title: Malachite & 24K Gold Resin Geode Art
galleryPhotos.medium: Epoxy Resin, Natural Crushed Quartz, Mica Pigments on Birch Panel
galleryPhotos.description: High-gloss luxury contemporary wall art featuring deep emerald and malachite rings accented with genuine quartz clusters and liquid leaf gilding.
